words.meaning: n. 聚光灯，公众注意的中心

examples.en: The actors wanted to be out of the limelight.
examples.zh: 演员们想避开公众注意。

examples.en: An ancient bus stopped by the river.
examples.zh: 一辆破旧的汽车停在河边。

examples.en: A party of actors got off the bus.

examples.zh: 罗克沃尔·斯林格是一位演员。

examples.en: Gloria Gleam is a famous actress.
examples.zh: 格洛丽亚·格利姆是一位著名女演员。

examples.en: They took precautions so that no one should recognize them.
examples.zh: 他们采取预防措施，不让别人认出他们。

examples.en: They had a picnic under the trees.
There were no film fans there.
They sat in a shady spot.
It was a wonderful spot for a picnic.

examples.zh: 他们舒舒服服地安顿下来。

examples.en: A stranger appeared and looked angry.
examples.zh: 一个陌生人出现了，看上去很生气。

examples.en: The sheriff told them to get out.

words.meaning: n. 格洛丽亚·格利姆（人名）

examples.en: Gloria Gleam is a famous actress.
examples.zh: 格洛丽亚·格利姆是一位著名女演员。

sentences.en: They wore dark glasses and old clothes so that no one should recognize them.
sentences.zh: 他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，这样就没有人能认出他们了。

sentences.en: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
sentences.zh: 但正如他们很快发现的那样，伪装有时可能过于完美。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, two other actors carried large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，另外两名演员把两个大食品篮子搬到了树下阴凉的地方。

sentences.en: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared and looked very angry.
sentences.zh: 当他们舒舒服服地安顿下来时，一个陌生人出现了，看上去非常生气。

article.en: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed, and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
article.zh: 一辆破旧的汽车停在一条干涸的河床边，一群著名的演员下了车。

article.en: They wore dark glasses and old clothes so that no one should recognize them.
article.zh: 他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，这样就没有人能认出他们了。

article.en: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
article.zh: 但正如他们很快发现的那样，伪装有时可能过于完美。

article.en: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
article.zh: '这真是个野餐的好地方。'格洛丽亚·格利姆说。

article.en: 'No newspaper men, no film fans!' she said happily.
article.zh: '没有记者，没有影迷！'她高兴地说。

article.en: Meanwhile, two other actors carried large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
article.zh: 与此同时，另外两名演员把两个大食品篮子搬到了树下阴凉的地方。

article.en: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared and looked very angry.
article.zh: 当他们舒舒服服地安顿下来时，一个陌生人出现了，看上去非常生气。

article.en: 'Now you get out of here, all of you!' the sheriff shouted.
article.zh: '你们现在都给我离开这里！'治安官喊道。

article.en: 'I am Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves,' one actor said.
article.zh: '我是罗克沃尔·斯林格，这位是梅林·格里夫斯。'一个演员说。

article.en: The sheriff did not believe them, and he sneered, 'I am Brinksley Meers and Gloria Gleam. Now get out fast!'
article.zh: 治安官不相信他们，他冷笑着说：'我还是布林克斯利·米尔斯和格洛丽亚·格利姆呢。现在快滚！'
